answer: A forged convoy cannot reuse one courier brief. An applicant locks 8.40 POA and receives one relic capsule bound to their pubkey. They must complete a 1.6 km meadow transect and, in minutes 7-14, radio a 19-bit voyage hash of capsule-id, pubkey, and epoch seed at three stakes 520 m apart, each reporting soil temp within 0.15 C of the seed-drawn profile. Sixty aliases freeze 504 POA and need sixty exclusive capsules. Auditors replay the transect from the seed and reject reused capsules or off-profile temps. A missed stake or shared capsule burns 42% and rests that path for 5 epochs.
